name: m4-branch-synth-scalap
description: As `m4-branch-synth-pekko`, the same commits of `perf-int-pekko-synth` (Scala 2.13.18 through upstream 2.13.x and the integration branch to the three uniques experiments , retronym/scala#256, #258 and #259), on scalap from scala/compiler-benchmark: a small corpus, so the same steps on a different shape of code.

On the M4, 3 rounds, xctrace ipc; compiler built with release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`). Patched JDK 26, `jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`; 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation (`-Xmn3g -XX:-G1UseAdaptiveIHOP`) and `-XX:hashCode=3`; timed iterations as the lab's other M4 scalap campaigns (20 warmup and 20 measured of 2 s): scalap compiles too fast for single-shot.
- `443d4c86ab`: [retronym/scala#259](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/259) part 2, patmat's translated match and uncurry typed with `TypeAssigner`.
